candidates.name: Pink Plaid Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The happy pink cannot overcome loud plaid, novelty styling, dropped shoulders and an oversized long streetwear body; neither material nor construction reaches Premium Formal.

candidates.name: Sky-Blue Textured Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The color is excellent, but the garment is an open rolled-cuff overshirt over a tee with a long rounded hem. It provides no Premium self-contained evening-shirt construction.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Gingham Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: Pale gingham, contrast buttons and a casual untucked body read conventional daytime smart-casual, without Premium textile or evening character.

candidates.name: Apricot Checked Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The warm check, open overshirt construction and boxy body are Casual outer-layer cues; the source does not prove Premium fabric or refined evening drape.

candidates.name: Muted-Blue Utility Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The broad dropped body and two large flap pockets make this a utility overshirt. Muted blue alone does not make it Premium Formal.

candidates.name: Purple Utility Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: Purple is welcome, but the very long boxy body, dropped shoulder and oversized utility pockets visibly lack Premium evening precision.

candidates.name: White Four-Pocket Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The safari pocket front, open Resort collar and beach presentation are incompatible with Premium Formal Evening construction.

candidates.name: Light-Apricot Mandarin Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The line is controlled, but the near-white linen surface reads lightweight daytime minimalist and does not prove Premium fiber, hand or expressive evening color.

candidates.name: Light-Gray Relaxed Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The cropped packshot hides rise, seat, drape and shoe break, while diagonal knee seams and a smooth technical surface fail a Premium tailoring gate.

candidates.name: Navy Relaxed-Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The broad dark leg puddles over the shoe and supplies neither precise Premium break nor the light Spring palette required.

candidates.name: Camel Wide-Leg Casual Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The low casual rise, broad cotton leg and heavy sneaker stacking are visibly everyday Casual, not Premium Formal tailoring.

candidates.name: Gray Drawstring Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: A fully gathered waist, exposed rope drawcord, black D-ring and synthetic drape disqualify this lounge trouser from Premium Formal.

candidates.name: Light-Khaki Relaxed Blazer
candidates.decisionReason: The original shows an extremely long boxy body, overlong sleeves, low patch pockets and thin flat cloth. It lacks Premium tailoring shape, drape and finish.
